newsitem.title: USA: EURO.NM partner sees market growing quickly.
newsitem.headline: EURO.NM partner sees market growing quickly.

text.p: EURO.NM, a pan-European market for high-growth stocks, aims to have as many as 500 companies listed in the next five years, according to the head of the Paris stock exchange, a partner in the venture.

"Our prospects are very bright," Jean-Francois Theodore, chairman of the Paris bourse, told reporters at the National Press Club here. "Without being overambitious, we forecast that within the next five years 400 to 500 companies will be listed on the EURO.NM network."
EURO.NM currently has 34 listed companies. Its members include the Paris Exchange's Nouveau Marche, Germany's Neuer Markt, Amsterdam's NMAX. and Brussels' EURO.NM Belgium.
All four of the markets belonging to the network have been fully operational since the end of March.
Theodore said the move to a single European currency would be "a plus" for EURO.NM. But he said the market's business plan for growth is based largely on the caliber of the companies that list.
Calling himself "a Europtimist by faith and by reason," he expressed confidence that Europe's unification will occur.
He added, "I am not a political wizard. But I do have a strong feeling as a European citizen and entrepreneur that EMU will happen on time" on January 1, 1999.
